title: A date content control whose format shows month or day names cannot be set in most languages
symptom: a date control whose format holds a full month or day name (MMMM, dddd) in a language other than English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese or Dutch, a short name (MMM, ddd) in a language other than English, a day period (AM/PM) outside United States English, or a token Word's date list does not offer, is refused with "unsupported date format"; validate_form reports "unsupported date metadata" and protect_form refuses rules naming it
workaround: give the control a numeric date format first (set_content_control_type, same name in Python, for example dd/MM/yyyy), then set the value; none through the CLI
